description: VoxSentinel ROHAN-003 speaker-verification evaluation set. Audio is NOT committed. Rebuild it with ml/scripts/prepare_sv_eval_set.py, which regenerates every sample from this manifest and verifies each one.
librispeech_selection_rule: For each dev-clean speaker, sort chapters by numeric id and keep those holding at least 2 utterances of at least 4.0s. A speaker qualifies only with two such chapters. Enrol on the first 2 utterances of the first chapter (sorted by POSIX path); probe with the first 2 of the second. Enrolment and probe therefore never share a recording session.
arctic_selection_rule: Speakers awb, bdl, clb, ksp, rms, slt, chosen because the Piper en_US-arctic voice can synthesise all of them. Enrol on arctic_a0001, arctic_a0002, arctic_a0003, arctic_a0004; probe with arctic_a0011, arctic_a0012.
clone_rule: For every ARCTIC speaker, synthesise both probe prompts with the Piper en_US-arctic voice using that speaker's own voice index. The voice is trained on CMU ARCTIC, so these are clones of the enrolled person rather than unrelated synthetic speech.
impostor_rule: Each reference is probed against the speakers at offsets [1, 2, 3, 4] in the sorted speaker list, wrapping around.

trial_relations.same_speaker: target: another genuine utterance from the enrolled person
trial_relations.different_speaker: non-target: genuine speech from a different person
trial_relations.clone: attack: TTS trained on the enrolled person; not counted in FAR
trial_relations.synthetic_non_target: attack: TTS trained on a different person; not counted in FAR

verification.librispeech: strict SHA-256 of the file, which is a byte copy of a fixed corpus file
verification.cmu_arctic: strict SHA-256 of the file, which is a byte copy of a fixed corpus file
verification.piper_tts: tolerant canonical-PCM check: sample rate, channel count, and sample count must match exactly, the Piper model and config hashes must match, and the frame-RMS dB envelope must agree within the tolerance below. Full-file SHA-256 is informational only, because Piper output is not bit-reproducible across ONNX Runtime execution plans.
verification.tolerance_evidence: Measured in ROHAN-002 and unchanged here; see ml/audio/fingerprint.py.

authoring_environment.note: Full-file SHA-256 values for Piper clone samples reproduce bit-for-bit only in an environment equivalent to this one. Cross-machine verification uses the tolerant canonical-PCM check.
